can_claim_now: The GitHub-to-Jenkins oya-ci-gate bridge is source-wired and remains the default dispatch path in checked-in gateway configuration.
The Rust oya-ci controller exists in source as the destination/core replacement lane, but checked-in gateway and Helm settings do not select it.

The root Jenkinsfile is stale Jenkins-surface hygiene debt; the active bridge evidence is the JCasC-wired infra/ci/jenkins/Jenkinsfile-oya-ci-gate path, and deletion is blocked until controller cutover gates are satisfied.
Current validation for this story is repository-local only; it does not prove a live cluster, production gate, or tenant workload readiness.
cannot_claim_yet: Jenkins is retired or safe to delete.
The bespoke oya-ci controller is the default live CI dispatcher.
Argo Workflows is the live CI orchestrator.
The PR-sourced gate security hole is fixed in the live path.
All branch-protection required contexts have reconciled producers under the bespoke controller.
Production CI is green for Oyatie Cloud tenant workloads.
GitHub Actions, external SaaS CI, or public-cloud CI is an allowed fallback.

nonclaims.text: This artifact does not claim the bespoke oya-ci controller is the live default dispatcher.

purpose: Define the durable G007 reconciliation contract for Oyatie Cloud CI/toolchain claims: classify live bridge versus destination CI only from evidence, block unsupported retirement/live/default/fallback claims, and keep volatile repo-topology facts in the companion snapshot.

stable_contract.contract_boundary: stable claim semantics live here; volatile current repository topology lives only in the snapshot artifact
stable_contract.retirement_gate_derivation_rule: delete_allowed_now may become true only in a refreshed snapshot that proves controller cutover, required-context producer reconciliation, host/sink reconciliation, and parallel-run evidence.
semantic_requirements: Classify Jenkins/custom-CI status from current evidence snapshot, not from historical ADR text alone.
Keep root Jenkinsfile hygiene evidence separate from the JCasC-wired active bridge Jenkinsfile evidence.
Keep bridge-only status context drift, reported-status metadata drift, and GitHub-bootstrap branch-protection versus GitHub status-sink split explicit while they remain true.

Forbid claims that Jenkins is retired/safe to delete, bespoke/controller CI is the live default, Argo is live, external/GitHub Actions/public-cloud CI fallback is allowed, or production/tenant readiness is green.
Treat path/snippet assertions as snapshot freshness checks, not a stable public contract.
